name.description: The package name, in kebab case, such as billing.

sections.description: The sections to make, separated by commas, such as contract,repo,runtime. contract or types is required. commands needs contract. repo needs runtime and --record.

record.description: The first record, in kebab case. It is declared in contract/, and repo/ gets its table. Needs contract. Leave it out for a package that owns no records.

group.description: The sync group of the first record: org, user, or <kind>:<field> such as space:spaceId. Required with --record.

summary.description: One line, at most 120 characters, for the primitives registry.
